in_marathi.name: Mitrata
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Friendly, Kind, Gracious
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mitrata हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mitrata is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'mitra', meaning friend. It signifies a kind, gracious, and friendly nature. In Hindu mythology, Mitrata is the name of the goddess of friendship, and she is believed to bring happiness and harmony to relationships. She is also the protector of women and children.
